findings.highlight: I breathe quietly
findings.evidenceJa: 呼吸を殺す
findings.governingReading: I kill my breathing
findings.explanation: Shirou suppresses his breath entirely; the English has him continue breathing.

findings.highlight: I don’t have much power
findings.evidenceJa: 持ち札はあまりに少ない
findings.governingReading: I have far too few cards to play
findings.explanation: A shortage of tactical options becomes low personal power.

findings.highlight: Caster evades Tohsaka’s question
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は他人事のように問いただし
findings.governingReading: Rin presses the question as though it concerns someone else
findings.explanation: Rin’s controlled, detached delivery disappears.

findings.highlight: he might be alive
findings.evidenceJa: まず間違いなく生きてる
findings.governingReading: he is almost certainly alive
findings.explanation: Rin’s near-certainty about Kotomine’s survival is weakened to bare possibility.

findings.highlight: filled with magic
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術の炎に包まれる
findings.governingReading: be engulfed in flames of magecraft
findings.explanation: The imminent fiery image is removed.

findings.highlight: Do you think you can beat me
findings.evidenceJa: 私たちに勝てるつもり
findings.governingReading: do you think you can defeat us
findings.explanation: Caster erases Archer from Rin’s stated matchup.

findings.highlight: he’s no threat to Archer if he knows his attacks beforehand
findings.evidenceJa: 事前に知っていれば私のアーチャーの敵じゃない
findings.governingReading: if we know about it beforehand, he is no match for my Archer
findings.explanation: The English makes Kuzuki the likely knower of his own attacks instead of Rin’s side having advance knowledge.

findings.highlight: a woman that will kill her own brother
findings.evidenceJa: 実の弟すら八つ裂きにする女
findings.governingReading: a woman who will tear even her own brother into eight pieces
findings.explanation: Archer’s identifying mythic detail is reduced to generic killing.

findings.highlight: I killed my own brother
findings.evidenceJa: 実の弟すら八つ裂きにした
findings.governingReading: I tore even my own brother into eight pieces
findings.explanation: Caster’s shocked repetition loses the exact accusation that identifies her legend.

findings.highlight: as if accepting everything that is happening
findings.evidenceJa: 善悪などないと
findings.governingReading: showing neither good nor evil, merely accepting events
findings.explanation: The morally unreadable quality of Archer’s expression disappears.

findings.highlight: that should not last for another day
findings.evidenceJa: あと一日保つかどうか
findings.governingReading: whether it will last even one more day
findings.explanation: Caster’s uncertainty becomes a prediction that Saber’s resistance will fail within a day.

findings.highlight: I barely stop myself from moving
findings.evidenceJa: 立ち上がろうとする足を押さえつける
findings.governingReading: I force down legs that are trying to stand
findings.explanation: The bodily struggle to rise is generalized into movement.

findings.highlight: take half your powers at most
findings.evidenceJa: その半身を断つ程度
findings.governingReading: at most sever half your body
findings.explanation: A graphic limit on bodily damage is changed into reducing magical power.

findings.highlight: Archer does not meet his Master’s expectations
findings.evidenceJa: 己がマスターである遠坂の思惑を否定した
findings.governingReading: he denied the plan of his own Master, Rin
findings.explanation: Archer’s explicit rejection of Rin’s strategy becomes passive failure to satisfy expectations.

findings.highlight: He is empty-handed as usual
findings.evidenceJa: その手はあくまで空手
findings.governingReading: his hands remain entirely empty
findings.explanation: The English inserts a habitual claim absent from the immediate staging.

findings.highlight: Don’t curse me, kid
findings.evidenceJa: 恨むなよ小僧
findings.governingReading: do not resent me, boy
findings.explanation: Archer warns Shirou against resentment, not literal cursing.

findings.highlight: He looks and smiles at me
findings.evidenceJa: ニヤリと、こっちを見て笑いやがった
findings.governingReading: he looks my way and gives me a damned smirk
findings.explanation: Archer’s knowing, provocative smirk is neutralized.

findings.highlight: Archer stands tall before her
findings.evidenceJa: 鋼のようなアーチャーの背中
findings.governingReading: Archer’s back, like steel
findings.explanation: The steel image defining Archer’s resolve disappears.

findings.highlight: who embodies Emiya Shirou’s ideals
findings.evidenceJa: 多くの人間を救ってきた
findings.governingReading: who had saved many people and embodied Emiya Shirou’s ideal
findings.explanation: The concrete basis for Shirou regarding Archer as a hero is omitted.

findings.highlight: She must be on guard
findings.evidenceJa: 警戒心を抱いたのか
findings.governingReading: perhaps she had grown wary
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative reading of Caster is promoted to necessity.

findings.highlight: I did not approve of you as my master
findings.evidenceJa: おまえを主と認めた訳ではない
findings.governingReading: I have not acknowledged you as my Master
findings.explanation: A formal authority relation is rendered as personal approval.

findings.highlight: I shall prove to the world that I am great enough to take you in
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方一人を御し得ないようでは私の器も知れる
findings.governingReading: if I cannot control even you alone, that shows the limits of my caliber
findings.explanation: Caster’s self-test of capacity gains an unsupported public performance before “the world.”

findings.highlight: this isn’t the time to be hesitating
findings.evidenceJa: そんな事に躊躇しているあいつじゃない
findings.governingReading: she is not someone who hesitates over such a thing
findings.explanation: A claim about Rin’s character becomes a generic judgment about timing.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka sighs
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は鼻を鳴らす
findings.governingReading: Rin snorts
findings.explanation: Rin’s defiant, ironic gesture is changed into weary resignation.

findings.highlight: My fingers are tense from nervousness
findings.evidenceJa: 指は緊張で固まったまま
findings.governingReading: my fingers remain frozen stiff with tension
findings.explanation: Physical paralysis is weakened to an emotional description.
